question_text: On 2025-12-08 (UTC), compare the morning rush window (08:00-10:00) versus the evening rush window (17:00-19:00) at Gate_MainEntrance for total person flow (person_entry + person_exit). Which window was busier and approximately by how much?
answer_text: Morning was busier. Total person flow was 1,191 (08:00–10:00) vs 997 (17:00–19:00), so the morning exceeded the evening by 194 people at Gate_MainEntrance on 2025-12-08 (UTC).

Average head count (mean-of-means) was 5.04 with a peak head_count of 13.0; peak event count for the hour was 194.

citations.cypher:
WITH '2025-12-08T08:00:00Z' AS m_start, '2025-12-08T10:00:00Z' AS m_end, '2025-12-08T17:00:00Z' AS e_start, '2025-12-08T19:00:00Z' AS e_end
CALL {
  WITH m_start, m_end
  MATCH (e:Event)-[:DETECTED_BY]->(c:Camera {camera_location:'Gate_MainEntrance'})
  WHERE e.event_type IN ['person_entry','person_exit']
    AND e.timestamp_utc >= m_start AND e.timestamp_utc < m_end
  RETURN count(e) AS morning_flow
}
CALL {
  WITH e_start, e_end
  MATCH (e:Event)-[:DETECTED_BY]->(c:Camera {camera_location:'Gate_MainEntrance'})
  WHERE e.event_type IN ['person_entry','person_exit']
    AND e.timestamp_utc >= e_start AND e.timestamp_utc < e_end
  RETURN count(e) AS evening_flow
}
WITH morning_flow, evening_flow,
     CASE WHEN morning_flow > evening_flow THEN 'morning'
          WHEN evening_flow > morning_flow THEN 'evening'
          ELSE 'tie' END AS busier_window,
     abs(morning_flow - evening_flow) AS difference
UNWIND [
  {window:'morning', total_person_flow: morning_flow},
  {window:'evening', total_person_flow: evening_flow}
] AS row
RETURN row.window AS window, row.total_person_flow AS total_person_flow, busier_window, difference
ORDER BY window
